milestone.title: Autopilot prompt-delivery stability — readiness settle window, working-aware stall detection, and `mp autopilot wait` / `tail`

intent.outcome: mp autopilot start reliably drives a runner to its target lifecycle: prompts are delivered only after the harness has been idle continuously for a settle window, a slow-but-working runner is never declared stalled, and chat operators can block on a run (`mp autopilot wait <id>`) and stream its activity (`mp autopilot tail <id> --follow`).

problem.description: M236's chat-driven dogfood surfaced three defects. (1) The readiness gate exists (drive/herdr.rs::send_prompt = wait_for_readiness + deliver_prompt) but is too eager: wait_for_readiness_with returns on the FIRST 'idle' read, and read_agent_status falls back to 'idle' whenever `herdr agent wait --timeout 0` exits 0 — so a freshly spawned pane whose harness TUI is still booting passes the gate and the prompt is lost. (2) Stall detection (drive/state_machine.rs ~663-680, drive/herdr.rs ~870-895) bails when agent_status is unchanged for stall_timeout_ms (default 1_800_000 at herdr.rs ~819, `--stall-timeout-ms` on start) — an unchanged 'working' status counts, so a long build or test run is declared stalled. (3) There is no blocking or streaming verb: mp autopilot status is a snapshot and operators poll activity.json by hand.

in_scope: WP1: add settle_ms to ReadinessOptions (default 5000; 0 = legacy first-idle behavior). wait_for_readiness_with returns only after idle has held continuously for settle_ms; any non-idle read resets the window; the existing timeout_ms still bounds the whole wait. Plumb `--prompt-settle-ms <ms>` on mp autopilot start.

WP2: stall rule — the stall timer accrues only while agent_status != working and the milestone lifecycle has not advanced; a working status pauses it. Hard ceiling: no lifecycle advance for 4 × stall_timeout (any status) still stalls, so a hung 'working' runner is caught. Default stall_timeout stays 30 min.
WP2: config knob agent.automation.stall_timeout_minutes (int 1..=240) in config.rs / config_docs.rs / config set validation. Precedence: --stall-timeout-ms > config > 30 min default.

WP3: `mp autopilot wait <id> [--timeout <sec>]` (default 1800) polls the run state (.mp/autopilot-run.state.json) and the milestone lifecycle; exit 0 with {reached: true, lifecycle} when the run's target lifecycle (or complete) is reached; exit 1 with {reached: false, reason: timeout | run-stopped | run-failed, lifecycle} otherwise.

WP3: `mp autopilot tail <id> [--follow] [--since <rfc3339>] [--idle <sec>]` prints activity events whose subject == <id> (oldest first, JSON lines); --follow keeps polling activity.json and exits after --idle seconds (default 5) without new events.

Tests use the existing fake-herdr pattern in crates/mp/tests/autopilot_drive_herdr_wait.rs and deterministic clocks (the *_with(now) seams); new binaries crates/mp/tests/autopilot_wait.rs and autopilot_tail.rs.
Docs: docs/autopilot/README.md and docs/mp/commands.md; `mp autopilot status --help` cross-references wait / tail; CHANGELOG.
out_of_scope: Exposing autopilot as a chat tool/function.
Pane management or herdr spawn timing (herdr 0.9.x drift patches are the baseline).

design_decisions.choice: Stall timer accrues only while agent_status != working and the lifecycle has not advanced; a 4 × stall_timeout no-advance ceiling applies regardless of status; default stays 30 min
design_decisions.rationale: Status-unchanged detection flagged long builds as stalls; pausing on working fixes that, and the ceiling still catches a runner hung in working. Keeping 30 min avoids changing behavior for idle-without-progress cases.

work_packages.name: Readiness settle window
work_packages.goal: Prompts are delivered only after continuous idle for settle_ms (default 5000), configurable via --prompt-settle-ms

work_packages.name: Lifecycle poller stall threshold
work_packages.goal: Working runners never stall before a 4× hard ceiling; idle-without-progress stalls at stall_timeout (default 30 min, config agent.automation.stall_timeout_minutes)
work_packages.rollback: Revert to status-unchanged stall detection; drop the config knob

work_packages.name: Chat-driven autopilot ergonomics (wait / tail)
work_packages.goal: mp autopilot wait <id> blocks to target lifecycle with structured exit; mp autopilot tail <id> [--follow] streams subject-filtered activity; documented
work_packages.rollback: Drop both new subcommands; mp autopilot status and reading activity.json by hand remain the only way to observe a detached session.

steps.action: Add settle_ms (default 5000) to ReadinessOptions in drive/herdr.rs; wait_for_readiness_with returns only after continuous idle for settle_ms (non-idle resets; timeout_ms bounds the whole wait; 0 = first-idle).

Stall rule in drive/state_machine.rs + drive/herdr.rs (wait_for_lifecycle_with): timer accrues only while agent_status != working and lifecycle unchanged; hard ceiling 4 × stall_timeout with no lifecycle advance regardless of status. Add agent.automation.stall_timeout_minutes (1..=240) to config.rs / config_docs.rs / config_cmd.rs validation; precedence --stall-timeout-ms > config > 30 min.

mp autopilot wait <id> [--timeout <sec>] (default 1800): poll .mp/autopilot-run.state.json + milestone lifecycle; exit 0 {reached:true, lifecycle} at target lifecycle or complete; exit 1 {reached:false, reason, lifecycle} on timeout / run-stopped / run-failed. Tests in crates/mp/tests/autopilot_wait.rs with seeded run state.

mp autopilot tail <id> [--follow] [--since <rfc3339>] [--idle <sec>] (default idle 5): JSON-lines activity events with subject == <id>, oldest first; --follow polls activity.json for appends. Tests in crates/mp/tests/autopilot_tail.rs (seeded journal; follow with an in-process appender).
Plumb --prompt-settle-ms on mp autopilot start (cli/autopilot.rs → commands/autopilot.rs → the ReadinessOptions built in drive/state_machine.rs).
Deterministic-clock tests: stall_working_runner_not_stalled (working 2h, no advance, timeout 30m → not stalled) and stall_idle_runner_stalls (idle 31m, no advance → stalled).

Docs + final verify: document wait / tail / --prompt-settle-ms / stall_timeout_minutes in docs/autopilot/README.md and docs/mp/commands.md; cross-reference from mp autopilot status --help; CHANGELOG; run mp nextest, clippy, fmt, consumer-surface lint.

steps.action: Fake-herdr regression in autopilot_drive_herdr_wait.rs: status sequence idle, working, idle... proves the prompt is delivered only after the settle window of continuous idle, and a mid-window non-idle resets it.
Deterministic-clock test stall_hard_ceiling: working with no lifecycle advance for > 4 × stall_timeout → stalled.
Config tests: stall_timeout_minutes_config (1 and 240 accepted, 0 and 241 rejected by mp config set) and stall_timeout_precedence (flag > config > default).
